profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a non-profit government research lab founded in 2020 and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). Its website describes the institute as a leading global scientific research center working to make advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere. TII develops the Falcon family of generative large language models, including Falcon-H1, Falcon-E, Falcon Perception, Falcon Arabic, Falcon Mamba 7B, Falcon 2 11B, Falcon 180B, Falcon 40B, Falcon 10B, and Falcon H1R 7B.

TII states that Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google Gemma 7B as independently verified by Hugging Face Leaderboard, and that Falcon Mamba 7B is the first open source released State Space Language Model. The site also says Falcon 180B has 180 billion parameters and was trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, while Falcon 40B has 40 billion parameters and was trained on one trillion tokens. TII launched the non-profit Falcon Foundation to champion open-sourcing of generative AI models.

Falcon (TII) is described as a UAE-hosted open-source LLM with Apache 2.0 licensing, sovereign AI positioning, and Middle East data residency. No litigation or MCP servers are listed for the institute.
